title: Grand Theft Auto VI Gets Cover and New Screenshots in Game Informer
seoTitle: GTA VI: New Cover & Screenshots Revealed by Game Informer
subtitle: The September issue features an exclusive interview and 12 screenshots of Rockstar's upcoming title
excerpt: Game Informer unveiled the cover of its Grand Theft Auto VI dedicated issue and 12 new screenshots, showcasing Vice City's map, dynamic weather, and details.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Game Informer has released its September issue featuring the Grand Theft Auto VI cover and 12 new screenshots, generating significant interest among fans awaiting its November 19 release.

New Images Reveal Grand Theft Auto VI Details

Twelve screenshots released by Game Informer showcase panoramic views of Vice City and surrounding areas, as well as action sequences. The images highlight the extensive map, the dynamic weather system with storms and hurricanes, and the detailed recreation of Leonida's fauna, Rockstar's parody of Florida.

Exclusive Game Informer Coverage

The November 2026 digital magazine dedicates 14 pages to a cover story that includes an interview with Rockstar designers and 12 exclusive screenshots. The article discusses how the developer researched Florida's culture and ecosystem to create a faithful and vibrant world.

Characters and Cover Art

The cover art features protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, produced by Rockstar itself. The image was described as a collector's item for fans of the series.

Other News in This Issue

In addition to GTA VI, the issue features previews of titles such as The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Metroid Ravenous, State of Decay 3, and Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, as well as interviews with Finn Wolfhard and comments from Mike Drucker on "good" bad games.

How to Access the Issue

The digital version is available starting September 29, 2026, and the print copy will be sent to subscribers in the United States and over 50 countries. The subscription includes ten annual issues, both physical and digital.

With information from Game Informer, Insider Gaming.
